intro: What’s new in each IsleMap release. Newest first.

entries.title: Official map, borders & sanctuaries
highlights: Choose Gateway or Gateway Official (official art is the default)
New Primal Pinas Border frame design
Welcome screen explains IsleMap is EAC-safe and won’t get you banned
Sanctuary place category with filter, rim stick, and hotkeys

entries.title: In-app changelog
highlights: Updates page now lists what’s new in each release
Required-update screen shows highlights for the version you’re installing

entries.title: Force-update polish
highlights: Installed version shows correctly in the required-update screen (no more v?)
Download finished no longer auto-opens the installer — click Restart & install when ready

entries.title: Group works in packaged builds
highlights: Pusher/Channels credentials are baked into the app so Group no longer needs a local .env auth server

entries.title: Group sync & durable data
highlights: Create or join a squad lobby and see peer pins on the overlay (username + PC ID)
Settings, identity, and custom places persist across updates
Map editor stays hidden in production builds

entries.title: Calibration & contributors
highlights: Improved Gateway coordinate mapping and wallow / focus controls
Contributors page added
Map place editor limited to developer builds

entries.title: Updater accuracy
highlights: Prefer GitHub Releases API so stale latest.yml no longer blocks updates

entries.title: Focus-aware overlay
highlights: Overlay shows only while The Isle (or map mode) is focused
Show map stays enabled across Alt-Tab

entries.title: Required updates
highlights: Newer GitHub releases can lock the map until you install

entries.title: Download reliability
highlights: Fix stuck updater downloads on Windows

entries.title: Unsigned Windows updater
highlights: Auto-updater works for unsigned Windows builds

entries.title: Branding & docs
highlights: IsleMap branding, expanded README, and release channel polish

entries.title: Initial release
highlights: EAC-safe clipboard-based Gateway overlay map
GitHub Releases auto-updater
